_source: Kit prices and bill of materials mirror holidaylightsdirect.ca / foreverlights.ca (Matt, 2026-09-04). All components are 12V.

components.name: 12V RGBW 5-Light Puck Strand
components.blurb: Five sealed RGBW puck lights on a moulded weatherproof lead. Each puck drops into the track and points down the face of the home.

components.name: Aluminum Track, 42" 5-hole
components.blurb: Extruded aluminum channel, pre-drilled for five pucks. Hides the wire and sinks heat. Black, white, wicker or brown.

components.name: WiFi Controller (WLED)
components.blurb: Joins your 2.4 GHz WiFi and drives colours, scenes, schedules and zones from the free app. Scenes keep running offline.

components.name: 12V 150 W Power Supply
components.blurb: Constant-voltage waterproof LED driver with a standard plug. Plugs into an existing GFCI receptacle.

components.name: 1 ft Extension Connector
components.blurb: Short sealed jumper for corners and narrow breaks in the soffit.

components.name: 5 ft Extension Connector
components.blurb: Mid-length jumper for gaps over a garage door or window bay.

components.name: 10 ft Extension Connector
components.blurb: Crosses a wider unlit span without adding pucks.

components.name: 20 ft Extension Connector
components.blurb: Reaches a separate elevation or carries the run back to the controller.

components.name: Power Injection T-Connector
components.blurb: Feeds extra power mid-run so the far end stays as bright as the near end.

components.name: Light T-Connector
components.blurb: Splits the light run so one controller output can branch left and right.

components.name: 20 ft Power Injection Cable
components.blurb: Extends the run between a power supply and the injection point.

components.name: Data Amplifier
components.blurb: Re-boosts the control signal on long runs so the last pucks stay in sync.

components.name: Colour-Matched Soffit Screws (100)
components.blurb: 5/8" coloured-head screws that disappear against the track.
